title: The diagonal Roos comparison respects signed shifts
statement: For every scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, every strict tower C of integral-coefficient cochain complexes, every integer r, and signed Roos shift data SY and SX satisfying both prescribed coordinate equations, the diagonal Roos comparison commutes with the shifts: α(C[r]) followed by the termwise shift transport and SX equals the image of SY followed by the complex-level shift transport and α(C)[r]. Neither boundedness nor completeness is required. [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict quotient and Roos comparison argument.

proof.text: For an arbitrary additive functor F, use the associativity and termwise commShiftIso to compare the shifted image towers. Verify the product/shift square by composing with each product projection, applying naturality of commShiftIso and the inverse piComparison projection equation. Compose the desired Roos equation with the shifted first cocone coordinate; the two prescribed first-coordinate shift equations and the scalarRoosMap coordinate equations reduce it to this product square. For the second coordinate, work in degree i and apply the same product square in degree i-1. The scalar (-1)^r passes through F by additivity. The second-coordinate shift equations and scalarRoosMap equation then identify both composites. The mapping-cocone identity decomposition proves equality in each degree. Specialize this generic calculation to the integral coefficient inverse-image functor.

theorem podReindexingRoosShiftCompatibility
    (SY : PodSignedRoosShift (scalarReductionSource l E Y))
    (SX : PodSignedRoosShift (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (hSY : SY.Laws) (hSX : SX.Laws) :
    ∀ (C : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ) (r : ℤ),
    (scalarRoosMap (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) (podShiftTower C r) ≫
      integralOperationsRoosMap (podTowerShift l E g C r).hom ≫
      (SX.comparison ((podReindexTower l E g).obj C) r).hom) =
    ((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).map (SY.comparison C r).hom ≫
      ((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).commShiftIso r).hom.app
        (integralOperationsRoos C) ≫
      (scalarRoosMap (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) C)⟦r⟧')
